question: Why cannot awareness experience cognitions on the opponent's own momentary view?
premises: The opponent holds that two cognitions do not exist simultaneously.
Experience of a cognition by awareness would require a relation not available within that restriction.
The opponent's own doctrine blocks simultaneous pairing of cognitions.
inference: Given the opponent's denial of simultaneous cognitions, an experience of cognitions by awareness does not fit their system.
plain_english: And in your view there is no pair of cognitions existing simultaneously; so an experience of cognitions by awareness does not fit anywhere in that system.
